jobs.title: (Senior ) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d) , you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it. You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. jobs.title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir suchen Dich! Wir, die Berndt Mobilitätsprodukte GmbH, gehören zu den führenden unabhängigen Anbietern von Liftsystemen in den östlichen Bundesländern. Seit über 20 Jahren sorgen wir mit individuellen Mobilitätslösungen für mehr Barrierefreiheit und Lebensqualität. Mit über 80 Mitarbeitenden im Innen- und Außendienst sind wir ein stetig wachsendes, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Was uns auszeichnet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein vertrauensvolles Miteinander und ein starkes Team, das gemeinsam etwas bewegt. Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir ab sofort einen engagierten Vertriebsmitarbeiter im Außendienst (m/w/d) für die Region Berlin und Brandenburg. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben: Du berätst unsere Kundinnen und Kunden persönlich vor Ort – einfühlsam, kompetent und mit dem Ziel, individuelle Mobilitätslösungen zu finden. Keine Kaltakquise: Deine Kundentermine werden durch unseren Innendienst bereits fest vereinbart und für dich geplant. Du verkaufst überwiegend Treppensitzlifte sowie gelegentlich Plattformlifte, Hublifte und Homelifte. Du ermittelst den individuellen Bedarf, nimmst die örtlichen Gegebenheiten auf und erstellst passende Angebote. Du führst Aufmaße durch und prüfst gemeinsam mit unserem Team die technische Umsetzbarkeit. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Innendienst zusammen und sorgst so für eine reibungslose Auftragsabwicklung. Du bereitest deine Kundentermine eigenständig vor und nach – teilweise flexibel aus dem Homeoffice. Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst schwerpunktmäßig Berlin und Brandenburg. Bei Bedarf übernimmst du auch Kundentermine in angrenzenden Regionen oder vertrittst Kollegen in anderen Vertriebsgebieten. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung – oder überzeugst uns als motivierter Quereinsteiger mit Verkaufstalent. Du hast Freude am Verkauf und ein gutes Gespür für die Wünsche und Bedürfnisse unterschiedlicher Menschen. Du trittst selbstbewusst, freundlich und überzeugend

Aufgaben Kickoff: Du führst Kickoff-Calls per Video mit neuen Kunden und klärst, wie die Prozesse, die wir für sie automatisieren aussehen. Setup: Du richtest KI-Systeme nach unserem festen, dokumentierten Standard ein und verbindest ihn mit den Plattformen des Kunden, zum Beispiel Mail, Kalender und etc. Onboarding: Du begleitest den Kunden, bis alles rund läuft – mit Onboarding-Call und einer Woche Feedback-Runde. Tempo: Nach der Einarbeitung betreust du mehrere Setups parallel und startest bis zu einen neuen Kunden pro Tag. So arbeiten wir dich ein Woche 1: Du lernst unsere Abläufe, unser Studio und den Setup-Standard kennen und baust deinen eigenen KI-Agenten, falls du noch keinen hast (inkl. aller relevanten Schulungen). jobs.description: Du willst Lieferketten nicht nur verwalten, sondern wirklich gestalten? Bei Rosental Organics übernimmst du die volle Ownership über unsere internationale Beschaffung von Verpackungsmaterialien bis zu Produktkomponenten und baust die Prozesse auf, die unser Wachstum tragen. Du hältst eine stabile Bestandsreichweite von 1–6 Monaten für alle relevanten Produkte und passt sie kontinuierlich an den Forecast an. Du entwickelst und pflegst klare SOPs und sorgst für eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit mit allen internen Schnittstellen. Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Verhandlung mit chinesischen Lieferanten. Du kennst die Hebel und holst das Beste für das Unternehmen heraus. Du bringst interkulturelle Kompetenz im China-Kontext mit und weißt, wie Kommunikation dort funktioniert (und nutzt das als Vorteil). Du erstellst stabile, datenbasierte Forecasts und Bestandsplanungen, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in gängigen ERP- oder Planning-Tools. jobs.title: Robot Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Why this role is exciting Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz , Knuspr.de , Kifli.hu , Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro , choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows. We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match. We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job. You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them. What you will own and deliver The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong. Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap. The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows. The first training runs. This role combines ownership of the tissue bank with practical oversight of delivery. jobs.title: CDI - Senior Product Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: Mission Ce que vous construisez ne reste pas à l’état de démonstration : de vrais utilisateurs, au sein de grands groupes, s’en servent chaque jour. Applications et agents se conçoivent et s’exploitent en binôme avec l’AI Product Manager. Une équipe sinistres retrouve ainsi sur un seul écran les documents utiles et un brouillon de réponse ; ailleurs, un processus de commande ne demande plus aucune ressaisie manuelle. Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que de vrais utilisateurs s’appuient sur ce que vous livrez. Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Product Engineer.   Activités et responsabilités À chaque projet, l’AI Product Manager pilote le produit avec le client : ce qui se construit en premier, et la vérification que les utilisateurs s’en servent, se décident à deux. Autour de l’application, trois métiers se croisent : les AI Engineers pour le comportement du modèle, les Platform Engineers pour le déploiement, les Context & Analytics Engineers pour les données dont l’application a besoin. Les tests se font avec les utilisateurs finaux, le code se relit entre pairs et les nouvelles recrues sont accompagnées.   Vos responsabilités : Construire des applications métier : front end, back end et API. Intégrer des agents et des assistants dans un processus métier, avec des contrôles humains là où ils comptent. Automatiser des processus de bout en bout. Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà. Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. About the Role The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention. This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation. You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption. Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar. This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Your mission At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible. As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib. Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products. What you'll do Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality. Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen , ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products. Champion an AI-first approach , exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently. Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices , working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization. Drive technical alignment across engineering teams , fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly

jobs.description: We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era. When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.description: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one model

jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description: About the role As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver. At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive. What You'll Do Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows. Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people. Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do. Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source. Own the gold layer and the semantic models

Ik werk bij de Customer Support afdeling van eHealth aan mijn eigen opdracht, waarmee ook echt iets gedaan wordt. Je krijgt hier veel vertrouwen en vrijheid om aan je eigen opdracht te werken en initiatief te tonen, maar er is altijd iemand die met je meedenkt. De open en informele sfeer zorgt ervoor dat je bij iedereen terecht kunt met vragen of gewoon voor een praatje, zowel binnen de afdeling als in de rest van de organisatie. Het is een fijne plek om te ontdekken wat je leuk vindt en om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een professionele, maar informele omgeving.” Kristi Imming – Stagiaire Customer Support PharmaPartners maakt software voor de eerstelijns zorg in Nederland, voor huisartsen, apotheken en patiënten. Binnen ons bedrijf hebben wij diverse afdelingen waarvoor we enthousiaste meewerk- en afstudeerstagiaires zoeken. Zoek jij een stage binnen een onze afdelingen, Research & Development, Innovatie, Sales of Support? Lees dan verder! Champion an AI-first approach , exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently. Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices , working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization. Drive technical alignment across engineering teams , fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly

jobs.title: Intern - Founders Associate (f/m/d) Fintech Startup (Serial Entrepreneurs) Starting in January 2027
jobs.description: We co-founded and led Viafintech (Barzahlen) to 100+ FTE, one of the most successful German fintechs, active in 17 markets across the EU and USA, and sold it in 2021 for a € three-digit million amount to NYSE-listed Paysafe Group. Now we’re off to our next venture. This time we’re building a global champion for prepaid products: gift cards (Apple, Amazon, Google), airtime and eCash, all in one simple API. Think of finperks as a Stripe/Adyen for all prepaid products and payments. We started in summer 2025. Since then, we’ve raised a $4M pre-seed round led by Motive Partners, built access to more than 1,000 brands across Europe, and gone live with 11 clients. Many people completely underestimate the market size: about €600bn sold per year today, going to €1.8tn by 2028. Instead of 5 players in the chain (brand → issuing tech provider → global distributor → local distributor → client), we connect brands directly with clients via the finperks platform. We’re a team of 20 in Berlin-Charlottenburg. A mix of our best people from the last journey and brilliant new joiners. High ownership. Low ego. Kind humans. jobs.title: Founding AE - DACH
jobs.description: Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid Type: Full-time Level: Senior Reporting to: Co-founder & CRO About Nebuly Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI. Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. jobs.description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines. Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control. What you will do: Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype. jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. You'll coordinate the specialists, keep work moving between teams and make sure every deliverable meets the quality and regulatory standard. That frees our domain teams to get back to their own work. What you'll own Usability studies: You'll own the study calendar, protocols and relationships with external labs such as Sage Research. jobs.title: Staff Analyst - Risk and Fraud Systems
jobs.description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: Build the data, decisioning and automated systems that allow Paddle to take more good risk while reducing fraud losses, unnecessary customer friction and manual work. Paddle’s Merchant of Record model makes risk a critical part of the product and its economics. Seller quality, buyer fraud, payment acceptance, refunds, disputes, reserves and card-scheme exposure cannot be optimised independently. This role will connect those signals, identify where the largest value is being lost, turn risk priorities into working controls and workflows, prove their effect in production, and establish a durable owner once a capability becomes repeatable. This is not a strategy-only role and it is not ownership of a large operational team. It is a hands-on build role at the intersection of risk, data, product, engineering and operations. What you'll do: Work hands-on with SQL (Snowflake, dbt), Python, statistics and modern AI-assisted tools to explore data, test hypotheses, prototype controls and evaluate results. Map the end-to-end seller risk system, its data, decisions, controls, owners and failure points. Establish the baseline before building: fraud losses, alert yield, time-to-detect, exposure at detection and analyst effort, with losses reconciled with Finance. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.  About the role: As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. jobs.description: About Everfield Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem. Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing. About the Role This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses. You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound. Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. As a Cloud Engineer, you will operate and support the cloud platforms that power The Exploration Company’s engineering, operations, and data workloads in France. You will design, deploy, and maintain infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud services so teams can work securely and reliably across both environments. This hands-on, high-ownership role sits at the intersection of aerospace and modern cloud engineering, with a strong focus on security, sovereignty, and compliance requirements. You will work on-site in France and collaborate closely with engineering teams to translate their needs into resilient, secure, and well-documented infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Design, deploy, and operate cloud infrastructure on AWS and SecNumCloud-qualified cloud environments, including managed Kubernetes, compute, networking, storage, and managed database services. Define and maintain a consistent architecture across AWS and SecNumCloud, including identity, networking, and secrets management, to keep environments comparable and portable where needed. Build and maintain infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) so all environments are reproducible and version-controlled. Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate infrastructure and application builds, testing, and deployment. Manage container platforms and orchestration, including Kubernetes cluster upgrades, networking, RBAC, and workload scheduling. Set up and maintain observability (metrics, logging, alerting) to detect and resolve issues before they affect engineering or operations. Enforce security and compliance best practices, including IAM policies, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, key management, and vulnerability patching. Support audits and compliance evidence collection for SecNumCloud and other applicable frameworks. Define backup, retention, and disaster recovery strategies for critical data

jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuellable in orbit - and potentially fly humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours. We are seeking a talented Combustion Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for contributing to designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines. Drive and/or contribute to injector design and optimisation against combustor requirements and design intent using theory and/or CFD. Support definition of instrumentation for hot-fire testing and assist with post-test data interpretation and CFD/model correlation. Reduce and analyse hot-fire test data to derive performance and combustion-stability metrics, and maintain associated data processing tools Support design reviews with clear technical justification of analysis methods, assumptions, and margins. jobs.title: Fixed-Wing Test Pilot H/F
jobs.description: About Alta Ares Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them. Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia. Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development. Role & Mission As a Fixed-Wing Test Pilot, you will operate Alta Ares' fixed-wing drones during development and demos. You will act as the Safety Pilot during experimental flights, ensuring mission success and platform integrity. Over time, you will also contribute to training, documentation, and continuous improvement of operational procedures. Flight Operations Operate fixed-wing UAVs during development tests and demos Execute manual piloting tasks, including executing non-standard or complex takeoff and landing procedures. Serve as Safety Pilot during avionics hardware and software testing, closely monitoring aircraft behavior and taking manual control when required. Work with the flight-controller team to provide detailed feedback on anomalies or unexpected behavior. Validate aircraft airworthiness and pre-flight checks. Aircraft Maintenance Prepare, organize, and maintain flight-test and demo equipment. Routine maintenance of the UAV Repairs and hardware adjustments Requirements Proven experience flying fixed-wing UAVs (required). Experience flying multirotor drones (preferred). Strong understanding of aerodynamics, CG balancing, and basic aircraft mechanics. Ability to troubleshoot propulsion systems, particularly turbines. Familiarity with flight-control systems, tuning, and parameter testing. Hands-on skills in maintenance and repair of UAV platforms. Strong safety mindset

jobs.title: RF Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space. As an RF Systems Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development, and integration of communication systems across our satellite connectivity and next-generation RF payload programs. You'll work on RF system architecture, signal processing algorithms, and performance analysis, collaborating closely with FPGA , embedded software, systems, and hardware engineers to develop and integrate complex RF technologies. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains. Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios. Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station) Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027. About this role: Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models. Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking. Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario. Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario. Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets. Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
